title: 017 · Broken tracking link in notification
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Vela Morn. From the case card: a notification for DL-017 points to a malformed path, and support must provide the correct shipment reference without asking the customer to follow an unknown link.

coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: get carrier support to give the recipient the correct reference through the verified channel and get the recipient's confirmation of access.

recipient.name: Vela Morn
recipient.responsibility: Report the broken link and confirm access to the correct shipment in the order portal.

notification_support.name: Notification support
notification_support.responsibility: Give the recipient the correct DL-017 reference and portal navigation through the verified order thread.

goal: Get the recipient the correct shipment reference without asking them to follow an unknown link, and have the recipient confirm access to the correct tracking page.
limits: Do not treat tracking access as delivery.
Do not provide a live URL or credentials.

intake.summary: The tracking link in the DL-017 notification does not work; the recipient needs the correct way to find the shipment.
